claim_text: The September 17, 2025 indictment in United States v. Aden et al., No. 0:25-cr-00349 (ECF 1) paragraph 24 alleges that the defendants shared a Platinum American Express credit card on which they accrued nearly half a million dollars in charges to fund and enhance their lifestyles, and that they paid those charges using Brilliant Minds company accounts. That is an alleged personal-expenditure figure paid from company accounts, not a Medicaid amount_billed or amount_paid total. It overlaps other Brilliant Minds dollars and must not be added to Falade figures or to FOF $250 million.

supporting_passages.quote: The defendants also shared a Platinum American Express credit card, on which they accrued nearly half a million dollars in charges to fund and enhance their lifestyles. The defendants paid those charges using Brilliant Mind’s company accounts.

amounts.methodology: Indictment para 24: nearly half a million dollars in Amex charges paid from Brilliant Minds company accounts. Personal lifestyle charges, not Medicaid billed/paid.

qualifiers: do not add to Falade or FOF $250M
editorial_notes: metric_type alleged_loss used for lack of a personal-expenditure token; wording must remain 'accrued ... charges'.
